summary: Chain Bridge I, a Cayman-domiciled blank-check company, filed an 8-K on November 6, 2026, reciting that holders at a November 2 extraordinary general meeting approved restating its memorandum and articles of association to push the outside termination date to November 15, 2027, a one-year extension from the prior November 15, 2026 deadline. Concurrently the sponsor-affiliated noteholder amended the unsecured, non-interest-bearing $1.25M senior note (C/M Capital Master Fund LP) to extend maturity from November 15, 2026 to November 15, 2027; no deal or consideration terms disclosed. Watch redemption levels and potential further extensions or wind-up.
